You will succeed by cultivating a culture of operational excellence, closing key business and roadmap gaps, and leading distributed engineering teams to deliver high-availability, highly secure platform experiences.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for GitLab Dedicated, and ensure the platform scales with customer growth and converges with GitLab's cellular architecture.</li> <li>Partner with Product and executive leadership to deliver on growth targets, with a focus on platform reliability, faster customer onboarding, infrastructure cost efficiency, and self-service administration.</li> <li>Lead the engineering teams that build and run the platform: tenant orchestration and integrations, resilience and incident response, the Switchboard control plane, public sector platforms and compliance, and enterprise migrations and import tooling. Uphold enterprise-grade SLAs across every tenant.</li> <li>Deliver GitLab Dedicated for Government: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP operations and audit readiness, air-gapped isolation, and public sector feature delivery.</li> <li>Make enterprise migrations to Dedicated predictable, repeatable, and low-disruption through self-service tooling and guided workflows.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and scale engineering managers across distributed teams, and bring practical AI-enabled workflows into how the organization works.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Security, and Customer Support to keep customer commitments, architecture, and investments aligned.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have led engineering organizations that run enterprise single or multi tenant SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms at scale.</li> <li>You have measurably improved production reliability, reduced toil, or lowered infrastructure cost on a platform you owned.</li> <li>You have deep expertise in cloud-native and cellular architectures, Infrastructure as Code, and modular services that deploy and scale independently across cloud environments.</li> <li>You have delivered and operated enterprise offerings under strict compliance regimes such as FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud.</li> <li>You have led organizational changes, including adopting AI enabled workflows that raise engineering system efficiencies.</li> <li>You translate financial targets into engineering investments, headcount plans, and execution roadmaps.</li> <li>You lead with ownership, speed with quality, and a focus on customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms organization builds and runs GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant enterprise SaaS offering, for GitLab's most strategic enterprise and public sector accounts. title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
description: Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt. Wer wir sind NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt. Warum diese Rolle Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt. Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop. Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt. Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen. KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist. Aufgaben Performance Creatives Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound. Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter. Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein. Social Media & Organic Content Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform. Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen. title: Sr. IT Systems Engineer
description: About Carrot : Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale. This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance About You ✨ You likely have: 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2) Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator) Why This Role Matters Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible. As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range). Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Perplexity when engineers research reliability Build and run an executive thought leadership program for our CEO and leadership team, including ghostwritten LinkedIn posts, bylines, and talk abstracts content calendars Driving content engagement through owned, earned and paid channels Growing executives’ LinkedIn audiences, with numbers to show for it (follower growth, impressions, inbound podcast or speaking requests) Improving brand visibility in AI answer engines and tracking it Google Analytics, Search Console, and Tag Manager, plus an SEO/AEO platform such as Ahrefs or Semrush *If you Nobody checks every box—we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.* Compensation We expect the salary range for this role to be $145,000 - $165,000. What Do We Care About: We Care about our People People are our critical differentiators. The company strives to treat our people with respect, empathy, and dignity. We expect that our people will treat each other similarly. In both cases, we will assume good intent. All are welcome at Gremlin. We know our differences make us stronger and that our best ideas and contributions can come from anyone at any level. We Care about Collaboration Gremlin is strongest when we come together as one team with shared goals. Be the glue, not the glitter. But as a remote company, teamwork and collaboration won’t happen by accident. We approach every challenge as a shared challenge. We rely on each other for diverse perspectives and creative ideas. The more voices and ideas we have represented in our business, the more we will all flourish, contribute, and build a more reliable internet. Gremlin is a place where everyone can grow and is encouraged. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Posting Open Date: 10-15-2026 Anticipated Posting Close Date*: N/A *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants. Solutions Architect - Delivery We are a diverse, highly skilled, and passionate team that values sharing and collaboration. We provide expert-level technical guidance to customers integrating our products into their application stacks. This means we are working with the latest innovations in technology, learning about them, and using our experience, considering how they are best used. Our engagement with customers starts with service onboarding, configuration migration, traffic go-live, and training. We also continue to work with customers as they get on board, helping integrate our services with their applications to ensure customers get the most out of Fastly. Our team comes from different backgrounds and locations. As we grow we look for people who can bring their own unique character and talent. We work flexibly, with a focus on delivering quality service to customers. Solutions Architects join our team with a wealth of experiences. What You'll Do: Work with new customers to integrate Fastly into their systems during their on-boarding Design and build technical solutions on Fastly, using VCL / Go / Rust / Javascript Provide existing customers guidance on additional features and performance tuning. Write and present training materials to customers and internal teams Work with Sales Engineers to build Proof Of Concepts for prospective customers Be the Subject Matter Expert on the Fastly Delivery and Compute platform What We're Looking For: Proficiency in CDN and WAF technologies, including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting. Expert knowledge of HTTP and web application implementation Troubleshooting supporting protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, TLS) Basic coding knowledge, including having built projects in one of Go, JavaScript, or Rust Experience with customer-facing technical consultant Experience with project management, including analyzing a project's requirements, designing and documenting a solution, and delivering that to successful completion Created training materials and mentored junior team members We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: Experience in additional programming languages Written and deployed automated testing ideally on top of continuous integration / continuous deployment systems Worked with infrastructure automation / configuration management systems Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours. Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements: This position is a remote role and open to candidates residing in the following locations: Pacific timezone (PST) Mountain timezone (MST) This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager. SF / LA Fair Chance Ordinance Statement Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Salary: The estimated salary range for this position is $122,280 to $172,632 Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location. This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs. Benefits: We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings? We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days. Why Fastly? We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives . Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day. We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about. We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying. title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
description: About Life360 Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU. You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps. Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build. About the Job This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science. You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution. You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You'll Do Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines. Own the MAU driver model and the forecast. Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU. Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request. Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams. Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test. Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team. Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment. What We're Looking For Required Experience & Qualifications 10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role. Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners. Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics. Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it. SQL, plus Python or R. Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI). Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work. Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Nice to Have Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects. Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science. Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams. Experience in a B2C subscription business. Core Expectations You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded. You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders. On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request. You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them. You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did. You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns Learning & Development programs Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. Life360 Values Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Diversity We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work. We are a diverse, collaborative group with an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship and delight in everything we create. With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design. The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360's subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. description: Who we are: Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Professionals in this role generally build on their SMB experience, handling larger, more complex accounts that require a nuanced understanding of the Motive platform and the customer’s operational challenges. We are looking for individuals with a track record of success, strong motivation, exposure to US customers, and a commitment to refining their sales and account management skillset. Strong interpersonal skills, a strong technical aptitude, and a high attention to detail are essential. Because of the collaborative nature of our Sales team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. Expect a fast-paced, quota-driven environment where adaptability is key. Proven experience managing contract renewals and mitigating churn to drive revenue retention. Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. Flex Fuels Ambition. About the role Flex moves real money at a serious scale, and someone has to make sure it only moves for the right reasons. We're hiring our first Financial Crimes Analysts to be that someone, and to build the function around them. This is a net-new role. You'll report directly to the Head of Financial Crimes and work side by side with the people who designed our financial crime program. Once a customer is through the door, you own what happens next: monitoring their activity, investigating what looks wrong, deciding what is suspicious, and writing the narrative that backs the decision. Your first priority will be working through our alert and case backlog and keeping the queue moving, which means a lot of hands-on investigation from day one. Our processes are still being built, so you'll also notice what's clunky, document it, and help simplify it. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have more room for bigger improvements. The scope is broader than a typical analyst role because the function is still taking shape, and the people who join first will set its standards and its reputation with our partners. This is a strong fit if you have a few years of hands-on financial crimes experience, enjoy digging into cases, and want to grow from running a process into helping design one, with a clear path into broader program responsibilities as the team grows. What you'll own You'll be a core part of financial crime detection and investigation at Flex. Post-onboarding risk. Own the question "is this customer's activity legitimate?" from the moment an alert fires to the moment it is cleared, escalated, or filed. The queue and the backlog. Your first priority is working through our alert backlog and keeping the queue current, with an eye on both quality and speed, so real risk gets the scrutiny it deserves and good customers aren't slowed down by noise. The investigation standard. Help set the bar for what a strong case narrative looks like here: clear, well supported, and defensible to a regulator or bank partner without a follow-up call. Detection coverage. Flag the typologies, patterns, and blind spots you see across cases and bring them to Risk, Operations, and Engineering, so they can become better rules and fewer false positives. The process. Document what works and flag what's clunky as you go. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have room to take on bigger improvements. Your voice. As one of the first official Financial Crimes Analysts at Flex, you'll see where the process works and where it doesn't, and you'll have a real voice in how the team grows. What you'll do Detect and decide Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts, applying BSA/AML typologies to separate genuinely suspicious activity from false positives Investigate unusual activity across accounts, payments, and cards, including patterns that point to money laundering, fraud, account takeover, and other illicit behavior Escalate higher-risk cases to supervisory review with a clear recommendation, not just a pile of facts Support UAR and SAR filings, working alongside senior team members and building toward owning filings end to end Investigate and document Write case narratives so clear and well supported that a reviewer, examiner, or bank partner can follow your reasoning without a call Conduct enhanced due diligence on existing customers whose activity raises concerns, and refresh customer risk profiles when behavior no longer matches what we were told at onboarding Pick up cases handed over by our KYC team when a flagged account needs a deeper activity review, and hand back what you learn so onboarding decisions get sharper Keep accurate, complete records in our case management system Build the program Help flag the patterns and process gaps behind noisy alerts or missed risk, and help turn them into better detection rules and simpler procedures Partner with Risk, Operations, Support, and Engineering to close open requests and, over time, tune monitoring Support quality assurance and file reviews, including for our bank partner program Stay current on evolving AML typologies and regulatory guidance, and bring what you learn back to the team What we're looking for You're comfortable with ambiguity, you make sound calls with incomplete information, and you can work a high-volume queue without losing quality. You have 1–3 years in BSA/AML compliance, transaction monitoring, fraud operations, or a related financial crimes role Hands-on experience dispositioning transaction monitoring alerts in a platform such as Sardine, Unit21, Actimize, or similar, with a working knowledge of AML typologies Exposure to fintech, payments, card programs, or BaaS program compliance Experience tuning detection rules or working with data and SQL to investigate patterns Working knowledge of KYC/CDD requirements and BSA obligations Exposure to suspicious activity reporting, including drafting narratives or supporting UAR/SAR filings Strong written communication: you can explain why something is or isn’t suspicious in plain language and summarize complex findings concisely High attention to detail, plus the ability to manage a queue and prioritize well A self-driven, growth mindset: you don’t wait to be handed the next problem, and when you see a clunky step or a noisy rule, you fix it and write down the better way Bonus points CAMS or another AML certification, completed or in progress Compensation Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. able to run multiple workstreams Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams The expected base salary range for this role varies by location: Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000 Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000 Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000 Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p> <p>Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.</p> <p>We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.</li> <li>Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.</li> <li>Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.</li> <li>Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluency in German.</li> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Prudential Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £64,000 - £80,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>Our Prudential Risk team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Prudential Risk team is expanding, and we are searching for a Manager to join our 2nd Line Prudential Risk Oversight team. You will be part of the broader 2LoD Risk and Compliance department here at Monzo.</p> <p>This represents a fantastic chance to contribute to a scaling bank with high aspirations. By joining the Prudential Risk Oversight team, you will champion our value to "grow Monzo safely." Your focus will involve collaborating with 1st Line Financial Risk to provide expert second-line oversight of their key prudential regulatory deliverables including the ICAAP, Recovery Plan and Resolution Planning. The role will also interpret and assess the impact of regulatory change and support the review and development of financial models used for financial forecasting, capital planning, and stress testing. </p> <p>Ideally you will have had experiences producing or reviewing regulatory submissions, the role will support the Senior Manager overseeing the ICAAP, Recovery Plan and across all RAF barriers, with a key focus on the financial risk barriers. You will work alongside the first line to provide in-flight review and challenge and complete independent assurance reviews on discrete areas of focus. Part of the role will involve reviewing stress testing outputs from Anaplan for the ICAAP, Recovery Planning and Valuation In Resolution, it would be beneficial to have experience analysing large data sets in excel/g-sheets.    </p> <p>A successful applicant will bring hands-on experience of interpreting and challenging capital prudential regulations and have the ability to develop and build strong working relationships with colleagues across the three lines of defence. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Supporting the oversight of key regulatory deliverable </strong>and enhancement plans in line with Monzo’s approach, regulatory expectations and industry best practices. <strong> </strong></li> <li><strong>Identification and interpretation </strong>of regulatory rules, providing oversight and challenge and ensuring these are applied correctly. </li> <li><strong>Support the production of reports and options </strong>on Monzo’s financial position and controls framework for key risk committees and the Board, making recommendations for ensuring controls are effective and prudential regulatory compliance. </li> <li><strong>Work alongside the Group Risk team </strong>to ensure Monzo’s Group Financial Risk Framework and Financial Projections Framework are adhered to, and that suitable controls and policies are in place. </li> <li><strong>Review financial models</strong> used for financial forecasting, capital planning and stress testing (including the ICAAP and Recovery Plan), owned by the 1st Line of Defence, within G-Sheets and Anaplan, including running sensitivity analysis and forming insights, observations and recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Conduct discrete pieces of assurance</strong> to support the strengthening of risk and controls in Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Develop strong relationships</strong> with colleagues to support the embedding of prudential risk management activity.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have relevant prudential experience</strong> gained within a bank, a consultancy, or a regulatory body.</li> <li><strong>You have a genuine desire to learn and grow</strong>, and you are excited about building enhanced 2LoD oversight within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.</li> <li><strong>Have in-depth knowledge/experience</strong> of the relevant regulatory requirements, specifically in relation to capital, recovery planning and resolution, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.</li> <li><strong>Have advanced Excel/ G-sheet skills</strong> and experience of building or reviewing financial models to support financial forecasting or capital planning, preferably relevant to a retail bank. </li> <li><strong>Are interested in analysing data</strong>, performing analysis and understanding the impact on our bank to form risk insights.</li> <li><strong>You are a good relationship builder</strong> who can develop productive working connections with 1LoD stakeholders across all levels of the business, whilst maintaining the ability to provide robust, informed challenge and review to ensure our safe growth.</li> <li><strong>Strong written and verbal</strong> communication style.</li> </ul> <p><em>We are looking for someone who has a strong foundation in several of these areas, with plenty of room and support to learn and develop the rest within the role.</em></p> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>The interview process: </strong></p> <p>Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Hangouts: </p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with the hiring manager for the role </li> <li>A role-specific interview </li> <li>A behavioural interview <br><br> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> </li> <ul> <li>💰 £64,000 - £80,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.<br><br></li> <li>📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).<br><br></li> <li>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.<br><br></li> <li>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br><br></li> <li>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br><br></li> <li>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">benefits</a>.<br><br></li> </ul> </ul> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!<br><br><strong>#LI-TK1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description: About Huzzle Labs Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance. About the Role Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance. This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Responsibilities Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books. Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly. Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo. Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears. Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.” Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria. Requirements At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing. Excellent written English and precision with numbers. Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria. Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension. Example Assignment For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would: Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work. Confidentiality An NDA must be signed before the engagement begins. Benefits Compensation: $60 - $90 USD / hour Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager
description: The role Envato is an all in one creative asset toolkit, bringing together world class creative assets and AI tools to help creative professionals bring their ideas to life. We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Envato on a contract basis and help us deliver some important product work. This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your first few months developing a new product vision or writing a strategy from scratch. We already know where we’re heading. What we need is a great Product Manager who can come in, get across a complex product area quickly and help us turn that direction into something customers can actually use. You’ll work closely with our Product, Design and Engineering teams, taking complex initiatives from discovery and definition through to launch, measurement and iteration. We’re looking for a safe pair of hands. Someone who knows how to bring clarity when things are messy, make sensible calls, spot issues early and keep work moving without needing a lot of oversight. What you’ll be doing You’ll take ownership of product initiatives and help turn established strategy and priorities into clear, actionable work. Then execute on this. You’ll use customer insight, data and commercial context to navigate trade offs, keep delivery moving and find smarter ways of working through AI, automation and agents. The emphasis is on execution with judgement. You’ll have plenty of autonomy, but you’ll be working within an established product direction rather than being expected to redefine it. What we’re looking for You’ve worked as a senior Product Manager in a SaaS, technology or digital product business and have enough experience under your belt to step into complex work without needing everything mapped out for you. You know how to take an initiative from an ambiguous starting point through to something shipped, measured and improved. You’re comfortable working with engineers and designers, can make trade offs when there isn’t a perfect answer and know when to make the call yourself versus when to pull others in. You’ll have strong product judgement, customer empathy and commercial awareness, and be comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions. We also want someone who is AI fluent. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using AI as part of how you think and work. Experience with GenAI products, AI enabled experiences or agents would be a bonus. Why Envato Our product is evolving quickly. Creative workflows are changing, AI is becoming part of everyday creative work and expectations around speed and what creative tools can do are moving with it. We’re building for the way creative professionals work now, while leaving plenty of room for what comes next. If you like getting into the work, solving messy problems with good people and seeing things actually ship, you’ll enjoy this one. Life at Envato We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. Our benefits include home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, and the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. A few things before you apply We embrace diversity at Envato and what to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant. title: Senior Brand Lead
description: Help shape how Envato ’s product shows up in the world Envato is an all-in-one creative asset toolkit, bringing together millions of creative assets and AI tools to help creative professionals make better work, faster. Everything we do in Marketing starts with the product: what it enables, the problems it solves and the momentum it creates for the people using it. That is where our Brand team comes in. We’re looking for a Senior Brand Lead to make sure Envato’s brand and product story are working together. You’ll help us translate what we are building into a brand that creative professionals want to be part of. One that feels useful, inspiring and distinctly Envato. You’ll be close to Product, Creative, Content and Growth, helping shape the thinking behind the launches, campaigns and stories that bring Envato to market. From a new AI workflow to a major product release, you’ll help uncover the customer value, find the strongest story and make sure the work lands with the people it is for. What you’ll do You’ll report to the Head of Creative and Brand Marketing, with the opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leaders across the business. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You’ll have room to shape the work, bring a point of view and turn good thinking into action. A big part of the role is staying close to creative professionals. You’ll be driven to understand how they work, what slows them down, what inspires them and what is changing in their world. You’ll bring those insights back into the team, using them to influence how we build, position and talk about our product. Some days that might mean working with Product Marketing and our Creative Studio to land the story behind a launch. Other days it might mean developing a campaign, building a partnership, working with an agency or spotting a cultural shift Envato should be part of. You’ll bring strong brand experience, instincts and commercial marketing judgement. You can take a complex product or customer insight and turn it into a clear, compelling idea. You know that great brand work is not just about looking good. It helps people understand why a product matters, gives them a reason to choose it and makes them want to come back. Who we are looking for We’re looking for someone with deep brand and campaign experience, ideally from a digital product, subscription, technology or creative business. You’ll be comfortable working at both the strategic and practical level, confident with senior stakeholders and motivated by the chance to help a product-led brand keep evolving. Most of all, you’ll care about creative work. You’ll be curious about new technology and AI, but equally interested in the human judgement, taste and craft that make the final result worth making. Life at Envato We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. Our benefits include home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, and the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. A few things before you apply We embrace diversity at Envato and what to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant. By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. title: Commercial Account Executive - Australia
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role This role can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll drive GitLab's growth by helping Commercialet organizations adopt, implement, and expand our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll also elevate your impact through team leadership and mentoring. You'll primarily focus on commercial accounts across the Queensland territory with opportunities in South Australia, guiding customers through their digital and DevSecOps journeys and driving pipeline generation that translates into measurable new ARR and long-term expansion. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab's field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle. You'll also mentor and coach fellow team members, sharing knowledge and learnings to elevate team performance. In your first year at this level, you'll deepen executive-level customer relationships, continue building a healthy book of business, and demonstrate consistent top-tier performance while supporting the growth of your peers. What you'll do Own and grow a book of commercial accounts in your primary territory across Queensland, focusing on organizations that can benefit from GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. Drive the full sales cycle with commercial customers by generating and qualifying pipeline through outbound prospecting, then leading discovery, negotiation, and close to create new ARR. Work with your key customers to drive adoption and consumption in new products. Meet or exceed quota by building strong, long-term customer relationships and acting as the primary point of contact for all commercial opportunities in your territory. Articulate the value of GitLab to commercial prospects and customers, clearly connecting our platform to their business outcomes, productivity goals, and security needs. Manage your territory by documenting buying criteria and processes, defining next steps and owners, and keeping opportunity information accurate and up to date. Create clear quarterly forecasts against your plan through regular pipeline and deal reviews. Collaborate closely with partners, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and Solutions Architects to drive new business, ensure adoption, and support expansion while minimizing churn and contraction. Represent GitLab in customer meetings and events by driving attendance and delivering compelling presentations, proposals, and reports that communicate value and outcomes. Contribute customer ideas to our public issue tracker and apply MEDPICC and Command of the Message on all opportunities. Mentor and coach fellow Commercial Account Executives, sharing sales strategies, customer insights, and lessons learned to help elevate team performance and contribute to team goal achievement. Regularly meet on-site with key customers to develop and strengthen executive-level relationships, ensuring GitLab is viewed as a strategic, long-term partner at the highest levels of the organization. What you'll bring Ability to drive complex B2B software sales cycles and build trusted relationships with commercial and Commercialet customers, ideally in a Commercial Account Executive or similar role serving Commercialet customers. Ability to quickly learn and sell a complex SaaS or DevSecOps platform to commercial and Commercialet accounts, including identifying and breaking into new customers. Excellence in operational rigor for deal management in Salesforce and Clari (or similar CRM and forecasting tools), with the ability to create reliable forecasts and manage your territory using both insight and data. Skill in managing and closing larger, more complex deals in the Commercial segment using proven multi-threading, negotiation, and executive coverage strategies. Self-starter who is a manager of one when it comes to territory account planning, quarterly and annual KPI execution, and driving new business acquisition and expansion through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions. Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach peers, share knowledge and learnings across the team, and take on additional team-level responsibilities that elevate team performance and collective goal achievement. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate value at all levels of the customer organization, lead clear and compelling customer conversations, and remain calm and solutions-focused under pressure. Experience driving adoption and consumption with customers whilst leading your account team. Outbounding: Not afraid to email, call, prospect into prospective accounts whilst building value narratives that land. Adaptability, flexibility, creativity and a desire to build something new! About the team The Commercial Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our Commercial customers. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and partner teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared territory planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on winning new customers, expanding existing accounts, and helping Commercial organizations get the most value from GitLab. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. title: Amazon Listing Grafiker (m/w/d)
description: ÜBER NEOLYMP Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse. Als Listing Grafiker (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die komplette operative Grafikarbeit, bist Ansprechpartner für alle grafischen Themen und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce eigenständig um. Du arbeitest alleine als Single-Contributor, ohne Teamverantwortung oder Personalführung. Es geht nicht darum, ein Team zu leiten, sondern darum, Aufgaben selbstständig umzusetzen und sauber abzuarbeiten. Aufgaben DEINE AUFGABEN Grafik- und Creative-Erstellung: Du entwickelst eigenständig verkaufsstarke Amazon-Listings – von Produktbildern über A+ Content bis hin zu Grafikmodulen – und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce professionell um.
