title: Teamlead Content Strategist (m/w/d)
description: ÜBER NEOLYMP NEOLYMP ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse. Aufgaben WARUM DIESE ROLLE Du bestimmst, was gebaut wird: Angles, Hooks, Konzepte, Funnel-Logik – du entscheidest, welche Creatives entstehen und warum. Das Grafikteam setzt um, was du konzipierst. Direkter Hebel auf Umsatz: Deine Konzepte laufen auf Meta und weiteren Paid-Kanälen, auf Landingpages und im Shop. Was du testest, siehst du in ROAS, CTR und Conversion Rate – nicht in Quartalsberichten. Führung mit Substanz: Du leitest ein Grafikteam, das Video und Statics in-house produziert, und gestaltest, wie dieses Team arbeitet, wächst und besser wird. Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong: Research, Konzept, Briefing, Produktion, Test, Iteration – die gesamte Kette liegt bei uns im Haus. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Performance, Shopify-Entwicklung und Creator-Management. Eine Marke, die noch Spielraum hat: Wir sind groß genug für echte Budgets und klein genug, dass deine Handschrift Sichtbar wird. DEINE AUFGABEN Strategie & Konzeption Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere Performance-Kanäle (insbesondere Meta) und unseren Onlineshop – von der übergeordneten Creative-Roadmap bis zum einzelnen Ad-Konzept. Du konzipierst Angles, Hooks und Formate auf Basis von Zielgruppen-Insights, Awareness-Stufen und Wettbewerbsanalysen und baust daraus eine systematische Testing-Pipeline. Du entwickelst und optimierst Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten konzeptionell – Aufbau, Argumentation,Einwandbehandlung – gemeinsam mit unserem Shopify Manager. Du setzt die komplette content-gesteuerte Seite unserer Sales-Events auf: Dramaturgie, Creative-Konzepte, Landingpages, Timing über alle Kanäle hinweg. Research & Positionierung Du führst Produkt- und Zielgruppen-Research durch: Wer kauft, warum, mit welchen Einwänden – und wie sprechen wir diese Menschen an? Du entwickelst die Positionierung unserer Produkte und entscheidest, an wen wir welches Produkt mit welchem Angle richten. Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerb und Plattform-Trends und übersetzt sie in konkrete Content-Hypothesen. Teamführung & Briefing Du führst unser Grafikteam fachlich und disziplinarisch, setzt Prioritäten, gibst klares Feedback und entwickelst die Menschen in deinem Team weiter. Du schreibst präzise Creative-Briefings – mit Zielgruppe, Angle, Hook, Referenzen und Erfolgskriterien – und sorgst für eine Produktion, die schnell, strukturiert und qualitativ hochwertig läuft. Du koordinierst mit Creator-Management und Shooting-Planung, welcher Content produziert werden muss, damit deine Konzepte umsetzbar sind. Analyse & Iteration Du analysierst die Performance von Creatives und Landingpages gemeinsam mit dem Performance-Team und leitest daraus Learnings, Iterationen und neue Konzepte ab. Du baust eine Wissensbasis auf: Was funktioniert bei welcher Zielgruppe, welche Hooks tragen, welche Formate skalieren. Qualifikation WAS DU MITBRINGST Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Scaling von Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta (und idealerweise TikTok, Google oder YouTube) – du hast Creatives konzipiert, die mit relevantem Budget profitabel gelaufen sind, und kannst darüber konkret sprechen. Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Team oder Kreativschaffende geführt, kennst den Unterschied zwischen Anweisung und Entwicklung und weißt, wie man ein Team gleichzeitig fordert und hält. Tiefes Verständnis für Direct-Response-Prinzipien, Awareness-Stufen, Hook-Mechaniken und Funnel-Psychologie – du kannst erklären, warum ein Creative funktioniert, nicht nur dass es funktioniert. Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Landingpages, Funnel-Seiten oder Sales-Events im E-Commerce / D2C. Das ist uns außerdem wichtig Starke Research-Kompetenz: Du arbeitest mit Kundeninterviews, Reviews, Umfragen, Wettbewerbs- und Ad-Library- Analysen und ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse. Datenkompetenz: Du liest ROAS, CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CPA und Conversion Rate sicher und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab. Exzellente Briefing- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit – schriftlich wie mündlich, mit Designer:innen genauso wie mit Performance-Marketern. Ein Blick für Gestaltung: Du musst nicht selbst schneiden, aber du erkennst, ob ein Creative dein Konzept trifft. Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung – du wartest nicht auf Vorgaben, du machst Vorschläge. Nice to have Erfahrung im Fitness-, Sport- oder Health-Bereich. Erfahrung mit UGC- und Creator-Content in der Performance-Produktion. Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in Research, Ideation oder Creative-Produktion. Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo oder Amazon-Marketing. Wir suchen für diese Rolle bewusst ein starkes Profil – jemanden, der schon unter Beweis gestellt hat, was hier erwartet wird. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns auf dich. Benefits DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. title: Security Engineer Junior - GRC
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🛡️ The role Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us. You'll join Alan's security team to help run our compliance and risk work across ISO 27001, HDS and DORA, across a growing number of countries and regulators. We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build, including how we govern AI across our products: assessing AI risks, setting the controls, and keeping up with the AI Act. You'll learn alongside experienced security engineers, with a dedicated coach from day one. You'll take on real ownership early, and your scope grows as we scale from 1M to many millions of members. And you'll learn how we work at Alan: teams own their risks and controls, we automate wherever we can, and we focus on real outcomes, not paperwork. 🚀 What you'll do Keep our certifications on track. You run the day-to-day of the ISO 27001 and HDS audit cycles: collecting evidence, preparing internal audits, and following up on corrective actions until they're closed. Turn regulations into practical actions. With Legal and the DPO, you help translate requirements like DORA, HDS, and GDPR into clear tasks for the teams, and track that they get done. Learn the health sector rules. You build your knowledge of health-specific frameworks (ANS, HDS) and help apply them to how we handle health data. Contribute to risk management. You help build and update our risk mapping, including AI risks, and follow up on the treatment plans with the teams who own them. Support the teams who own the controls. You keep the controls framework up to date, answer teams' questions, and help explain security clearly to every stakeholder, from engineers to managers. Support incident governance. You help classify and document incidents, keep Business continuity and Disaster recovery plans up to date, and prepare inputs for DORA incident reports. Automate what slows us down. You spot repetitive compliance tasks and automate them with scripts, tools or AI. 🏗️ What you'll help build One compliance backbone: A single control system for several regulators in several countries, so Alan can scale without rebuilding compliance each time. An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems with scripts and AI, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush. You'll work closely with Legal, the DPO, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams. ⭐ What we're looking for You want to do the work yourself and grow with it: a permanent, hands-on role where you build things for the long run. 2+ years in security, GRC or compliance (an audit background is fine if you want to move into building). You've played a key part in a certification or audit cycle (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2 or similar). You're curious about how things work technically, and you've automated at least one manual task (a script, a tool, an AI workflow). You're fluent in French and English, and comfortable presenting in both. You learn fast, ask for feedback, and go into the details when it matters. 🌍 How we work Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain. Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility. 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. You want to know more about Alan? 🙌 Perks & Benefits : Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 🤘 A strong culture : People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. title: Business Solutions Architect
description: About Us: Endpoint is an interactive response technology (IRT®) systems and solutions provider that supports the life sciences industry. Business Solutions Architects work closely with the client, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure that each system is built and updated to meet the needs of the protocol. The Business Solutions Architect (BSA) independently delivers business analysis for low-to-medium complexity initiatives. The role translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements and ensures alignment between business and technical teams. Responsibilities: Demonstrate strong working knowledge of technologies used in life sciences and clinical trial environments, including RTSM platforms. Lead requirements elicitation and documentation for assigned initiatives, translating business needs into clear, actionable, and compliant functional requirements. Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions and process reviews to drive shared understanding of study and system needs. Collaborate with clients to elicit, analyse, and document system requirements, enhancements and changes throughout the study lifecycle. Analyse business processes, data flows, and system interactions to ensure alignment between business objectives and technical solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert on assigned clinical study protocols, supporting studies of moderate to high complexity. Author clear, accurate, and compliant functional specifications for RTSM systems, including randomization, kit lists, integrations and interfaces. Partner effectively with internal teams (Project Management, Development, QA, Operations, and Support) to advance initiatives through all phases of the development lifecycle. Support UAT planning, execution and defect triage, ensuring timely issue resolution and optimal study designs. Manage requirements changes in line with established governance and escalation processes, ensuring traceability and risk awareness. Continuously expand knowledge of Endpoint platforms, processes and offerings as they evolve. Understand and assess the operational and strategic impact of system issues (e.g., unblinding risk, supply shortages, patient randomization or dosing challenges). Apply and reinforce Endpoint processes while supporting client‑specific study designs and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate with process owners and provide constructive feedback to improve study maintenance and operational efficiency. Identify risks and issues early, escalating appropriately based on impact and urgency. Manage system designs across multiple studies and client templates, ensuring consistency and quality. Build trust through transparency, accountability and the ability to engage in clear, respectful and constructive conversations when needed. Perform other duties as assigned, consistent with business needs and the scope of the position. Accountabilities: Demonstrates timely, accurate and high‑quality delivery of Business Analysis outputs within assigned initiatives. Is accountable for maintaining clear, complete and traceable requirements that support compliant and effective system designs. Effectively utilises available resources to support on‑time study delivery while maintaining appropriate oversight and accountability. Builds and maintains effective working relationships with stakeholders, demonstrating confident facilitation and professional stakeholder management. Delivers work with a consistent level of reliability, quality and attention to detail, reflecting solid Business Analysis capability and accountability for outcomes. Authority: The Business Solutions Architect is authorised to own Business Analysis deliverables within the assigned scope of work. Makes analysis and requirements decisions within established frameworks, standards and governance processes, escalating where impact or risk exceeds defined thresholds. Is authorised to engage directly with business users, subject matter experts and delivery teams to elicit requirements, validate solutions and support study delivery. May assess and communicate risks related to RTSM system designs, requirements changes and study impacts, providing informed recommendations within established governance and escalation frameworks. Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred; appropriate experience in the RTSM industry may substitute for the degree requirement. Experience: 2+ years of experience in clinical trials, RTSM/IRT, clinical supply chain, or a related life sciences/technology field 2-4 years experience in the life science industry . title: Partnerships Manager, Ecosystem
description: PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER, ECOSYSTEM ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform built for developers. We provide a complete backend solution — Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search — all deeply integrated and designed to scale. Millions of developers build on Supabase. We're remote-first, async-native, and we move fast. ABOUT THE ROLE We're in the early days of building our partner marketplace program, and this role is foundational to it. You'll help lay the groundwork for what this program becomes — starting by owning two critical pieces: deep account management for our top marketplace and referral partners, and vetting the intake of new partnership requests. You'll take a focused set of high-priority partners and go deep — building the co-marketing and co-sell motion that drives real user growth — while also serving as the first filter for new partner opportunities coming into the pipeline. What you'll do Partner Account Management - Develop and execute co-marketing and co-sell strategies with each partner to drive user growth - Own day-to-day relationship management for a focused portfolio of top marketplace and referral partners - Report on partner performance and progress — adoption, attribution, revenue impact — to internal stakeholders - Coordinate integration support and ensure partners have what they need to succeed post-signature Partner Intake & Routing - Vet incoming partnership requests and evaluate fit against our partnership criteria - Ensure new partners are routed and bucketed correctly across the right internal programs - Own partner onboarding — getting new partners set up and moving smoothly from signed agreement to active partner - Flag high-potential opportunities for further evaluation or escalation Who you are - 5-10 years of experience in Partnerships, referral marketing, or channel sales - Experience helping build a marketplace from 0 to 1 - Domain expertise spanning PLG motions, integrations, marketplace ecosystems, and devtools/database companies — you understand how developers evaluate and adopt infrastructure tooling, and you've seen how partner programs operate from the inside - Track record of driving co-marketing and co-sell campaigns that delivered measurable results, with a solid grasp of attribution - Fluent working across modern tool stacks — Notion, Linear, Slack, Claude, and similar systems — as part of your daily workflow Nice to have - Prior experience at an early-stage startup - Hands-on experience building with Supabase or AI-powered tools (Lovable, Bolt, Figma, v0, etc.) We Offer - 100% remote, no location-based salary adjustments - Autonomous work environment - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental — 100% for employees, 80% for dependents - Tech Allowance + Annual Education Allowance - Annual company off-sites WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Associate Renewals Manager, SMB
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.</li> <li>Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or remote work best practices.</li> <li>Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.</li> <li><span class="s1">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
description: About Us Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications. About the Team Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design. About the Role As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols. Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools. Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation. Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues. Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software. Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security. What We're Looking For Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts. Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development. Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports. Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection). Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems. Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset. If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you! About Working With Us Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats. Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc , our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity . title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
description: Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value. As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement. Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes. Key Duties & Responsibilities: As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities: Customer Technical Adoption Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship. Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives. Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives. Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case. Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. Product Expertise Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems. Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap. Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem. Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs. Industry Expertise Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy. Requirements Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered. Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities. Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc. Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise. Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus. Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives. Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred. We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. title: Head of New Media
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Traditional PR is fading — we go directly to our audience. This role brings together what used to be two separate seats, communications and social media, into one mid-to-senior, hands-on role: owning Supabase's voice in the channels where developers actually pay attention, and building our founders' presence in them. "New media" here means modern and direct, not traditional press — we care far more about getting our founders onto the right podcasts and YouTube channels than landing a New York Times placement. It's part comms, part social operator, with a sharper edge than a typical polite PR hire: someone willing to put an opinion out there and push a little rather than always play it safe. But it's not just a social media job either — this person also needs the poise and technical credibility to lead comms through genuinely high-stakes moments, like a major incident, where reporters, investors, and customers all need a calm, credible, technically fluent voice at the same time. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Make sure we're part of the current conversation and are going directly to our audience — new media over old-world press - Own and execute our new media strategy - Run and grow Supabase's X + LinkedIn accounts, hands on keyboard - Help build the accounts of our founders and team — including ghostwriting in their voice - Explore and exploit unconventional channels and formats - Book our cofounders on the most known shows, podcasts, and YouTube channels in our space - Work directly with DevRel and the PMM team on launches and Select - Manage comms around incidents, funding, and other high-stakes moments — crisis comms handled with poise and technical credibility (this is key) YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Excellent writer with a distinctive voice — equally strong posting as yourself and ghostwriting for others - Track record of growing accounts, ideally for a technical audience - Unconventional thinker — willing to put an opinion out there and push a little, with the judgment to know when - Seasoned enough for the serious moments — incidents, funding, press — calm, credible, and technically fluent - High agency — you're probably already doing a version of this somewhere scrappier WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. As artificial intelligence agents increasingly write and manage code alongside people, you'll build backend capabilities and interfaces that support trustworthy collaboration between people and agents.</p> <p>You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL to improve critical source code experiences across GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. performant systems.</p> <p>Learn more about the <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/devops/create/source-code/">Create:Source Code teams</a> in the GitLab value="8">Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li value="3">Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.</li> <li value="4">Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li value="5">Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.</li> <li value="6">Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take title: Growth Marketer, Creators & Channels
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Creator and UGC content is only getting bigger as a growth channel for developer tools, and right now Supabase reaches it mostly at arm's length, through agencies that own the actual relationships with creators. This role exists to change that: bring our creator/influencer program fully in-house, own those relationships directly, and grow the program into a multi-million-dollar channel. A good marker of success looks like a roster of around 50 active creators within the first year — at which point we take what worked and go find the next channel to unlock the same way. This is a growth and marketing role first, not a DevRel or engineering-adjacent one — we're optimizing less for technical depth and more for someone outgoing enough that creators want to work with them directly, creative enough to keep testing new formats and strategies, and operationally strong enough to run the budgets and reporting behind it. The work is currently split on an interim basis across a couple of people on the marketing team; this role is being created to own it end to end. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Source, recruit, and manage direct relationships with content creators (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) - Design and run creator campaigns end to end - Find and test new acquisition channels and strategies — lots of small experiments, doubling down on what works - Operationalize and report on these programs: budgets, tracking, results - Grow with the role: the remit could develop into owning all content from a growth perspective, beyond creators and UGC YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - 3+ years in growth, partnerships or creator marketing at a dev tool, SaaS or consumer tech company - Track record of launching channels from zero — and turning winners into repeatable programs - Outgoing relationship-builder creators genuinely want to work with - Strong operator. Comfortable with spreadsheets. - Ideally already doing a version of this somewhere scrappier or more startup — someone thriving at a smaller company is a better signal here than someone comfortable (but not standout) at a big-name platform WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. title: Senior Marketing Manager
description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to turn Yubo's brand ambition into brilliant, effective marketing, from major campaign moments to paid and owned-channel activity, and the smaller tests that help us learn what works. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Communications, you will translate Yubo's brand strategy into an executable US marketing programme. You will lead integrated brand campaigns, own campaign and paid-media planning and management, and build and manage influencer capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and execution. You will challenge plans constructively, make recommendations grounded in insight and data, and work closely with Creative, PR, Product, UA, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal to deliver marketing that builds the brand and drives growth. The role will focus on the US first, with scope to contribute to expansion into new markets as Yubo's marketing activity grows. This is a freelance position on a 6-month contract, with a target start of Q4 2026. Your responsibilites Turn strategic priorities into impactful marketing activity Lead the development and execution of Yubo's priority brand campaigns in the US, from insight and strategy through briefing, delivery, optimisation and reporting. Translate Yubo's positioning, audience priorities and seasonal moments into cultural marketing activity that earns attention amongst Gen Z. Develop integrated channel plans across paid, earned and owned activity, working closely with PR and Creative to ensure every channel plays a clear role. Own campaign budget planning and day-to-day management, partnering closely with UA on paid-media strategy and optimisation. Explore new, less traditional ways for Yubo to reach and engage people, challenging default channel choices and designing approaches that make marketing work harder. Establish brand marketing operations and measurement Establish effective working rhythms across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data, from briefing and approvals to reporting and learning. Work closely with Data and UA to analyse performance and make clear, evidence-based optimisation recommendations. Build clear measurement plans so every campaign, test and experiment informs future investment and potential expansion into new markets. Identify, recommend and deliver smaller tests and experiments that help Yubo learn quickly and improve future investment. Build influencer, social and community activity Build the plans, operating models and internal capability needed to deliver consistently strong influencer activity and integrate it into wider campaign plans. Manage influencer agency relationships, negotiating cost-effective partnership models that maximise impact and effectiveness. Who you are You are an experienced brand marketer with strong consumer instincts and a genuine interest in youth culture. You know how to turn a positioning and a business objective into a campaign people notice, and how to turn campaign results into smarter decisions next time. You are as comfortable building a strategic recommendation as you are writing a brief, reviewing creative, shaping a media plan, interrogating performance data or getting into the practical detail needed to make work happen. You don't wait for perfect information or a fully formed process; you create clarity, bring people together and move work forward. You will bring: A breadth of experience in brand and integrated marketing, ideally in a high-growth tech, consumer app, entertainment, lifestyle or youth-culture business. A track record of developing and delivering integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, working closely with cross-functional partners. An understanding of the US market and how 18–24-year-olds engage with brands, culture and social platforms. Experience owning campaign and paid-media planning and management, ideally in close partnership with performance marketing, creative and comms teams. Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into clear optimisation and investment recommendations. Experience working closely with creative teams to develop strong campaign platforms, briefs and work that is both strategically sharp and creatively ambitious. A curiosity for less traditional channels, partnerships and approaches, with the creativity to test new ways of reaching people and maximise earned attention above what we buy. A proactive, autonomous and highly collaborative working style. Within a month, you will Get up to speed on Yubo's brand, product, US market and audience. Meet your key stakeholders across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data. Review current campaign activity, budgets and ways of working. Start shaping the US marketing calendar and briefs with the Director of Brand & Communications. Within 3 months, you will Be leading delivery of Yubo's US campaigns, with briefs, channel plans and budgets in place. Have established the operating model between Brand, UA, Creative, PR, Product and Data. Be building the campaign measurement framework. Have started shaping Yubo's influencer marketing approach, including early agency conversations. Within 6 months, you will Have delivered Yubo's priority US brand campaigns end to end, from strategy through reporting. Have embedded the cross-functional operating model and measurement framework. Have established influencer marketing at Yubo, with agency partnerships operating. Have delivered key tests and experiments, with recommendations to inform 2027 priorities. The recruitment process First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition A technical test with Alex, our Brand Director Our approach to privacy & safety As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts. Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact. Here’s how we live our mission every day: Y ou own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter U nconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better B e Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward O ne team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you. Enjoy Top-notch Benefits Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits: Cool Workplace : enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options Team Activities : participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities Family-Friendly : we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies Wellness Programs : benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Director, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid) </p> <h3><strong>Engineering at Monzo</strong></h3> <p>Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.</p> <p>The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.</p> <p>Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.</p> <p>As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.</p> <p>Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.</p> <p>This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll work on</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.</li> <li>Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.</li> <li>Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.</li> <li>Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.</li> <li>Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.</li> <li>Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.</li> <li>Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.</li> <li>Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.</li> <li>Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You should apply if</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.</li> <li>You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.</li> <li>You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.</li> <li>You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.</li> <li>You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.</li> <li>You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The interview process</strong></h3> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.</li> </ol> <p>At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.<br><br></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£42,500 - £55,500 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p>We are looking for a results driven Senior Growth Marketing Executive to help us launch and scale Monzo Business across our growing European markets.</p> <p>You’ll play a key role in delivering our EU growth strategy, taking ownership of the day-to-day execution and optimisation of our Direct Mail campaigns, while also supporting activity across Paid Social and where needed, Search too. </p> <p>We're looking for someone with strong hands-on Direct Mail experience who is excited to broaden their performance marketing skills. You'll help us take what we've learned from growing Monzo Business in the UK and our early European markets, test how those playbooks translate locally, and build new approaches where they don't.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on campaign execution, working across multiple channels and markets, and using data to continually test, learn and improve performance.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the end-to-end delivery of activity across our European markets, from campaign planning and set up through to optimisation, measurement and reporting</li> <li>Take a leading role in delivering and optimising our Direct Mail activity, including audience selection, campaign planning, creative development, supplier coordination, testing and performance analysis</li> <li>Support campaign execution across Paid Social and Paid Search, working closely with our channel managers to launch and optimise activity</li> <li>Help develop testing strategies around account structure, campaign planning, experiments, and creative roadmaps</li> <li>Work closely with local market teams and our Brand, Integrated Marketing, Creative, Product and Data teams to deliver campaigns that are locally relevant and grounded in customer insight</li> <li>Share learnings across the wider Growth Marketing team, helping us build repeatable playbooks for launching Monzo Business in new markets</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You put the customer first. We’re a mission-led company and everything we do is to benefit our customers</li> <li>You take a ‘test and learn’ approach and love agile ways of working</li> <li>You have experience delivering Direct Mail campaigns, ideally within an acquisition or growth marketing environment</li> <li>You have experience across, or are curious to expand your skills into, other performance channels such as Paid Social and Paid Search</li> <li>You like to use data to tell a story about performance and understand how our business customers engage with us</li> <li>You’re highly organised and enjoy getting campaigns from idea through to execution, coordinating across different teams and partners</li> <li>Experience in financial services, B2B marketing or international markets is a plus, but not essential</li> </ul> <p><strong>The team</strong></p> <p>You’ll join our Growth Marketing team at Monzo and report into Ashil Shavdia, Growth Marketing Lead (Business Banking). </p> <p>You’ll work closely with our Paid Search, Paid Social and Direct Mail specialists, as well as colleagues across our European markets, Integrated Marketing, Product and Data teams. </p> <p>You’ll be joining at an exciting stage of Monzo Business’s European expansion, helping us establish how we acquire customers efficiently in new markets and build the playbooks we can use as we continue to grow.</p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call (30mins)</li> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Role Specific & Behavioural Interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>£42,500 - £55,500 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts. They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part. They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines. They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs. They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session. What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance. How we build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level. Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change. Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters. Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice. Recent work Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked. A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half. Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice. Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66. A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people. What we look for You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working. You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security. You build the eval before you trust the result. You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°. Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics. Stack Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry Pay UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity. title: Senior / Lead Developer - Core Data Services (SAP BTP) (m/f/d)
description: Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery. SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms. We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end. A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future! About the Role Join us in shaping the next generation of digital customer experiences in the financial services industry. As a Senior / Lead Developer for Core Data Services , you will drive technical architecture decisions, lead implementation activities on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), and help deliver scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions in a highly collaborative environment. In this role, you will take end-to-end technical ownership for Core Data Services development within a large-scale customer portal transformation program. You will combine hands-on development with technical leadership, guiding architecture decisions, mentoring developers, and ensuring the successful delivery of SAP BTP-based solutions through to go-live. Key responsibilities Lead the design and development of Core Data Services for customer-facing portal applications on SAP BTP and SAP RISE, following Clean Core principles. Define and maintain technical and architecture concepts, support quality gates, and ensure alignment with project and enterprise architecture standards. Design and implement modular services using the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), including integrations through the SAP BTP Integration Suite. Establish secure authentication and authorization concepts, including XSUAA, role management, and access control frameworks. Provide technical leadership to the development team through code reviews, mentoring, release governance, documentation, and deployment readiness activities. Requirements Several years of hands-on software development experience on SAP BTP, ideally within Clean Core transformation projects. Proven expertise with RAP and/or CAP and the development of enterprise-grade cloud applications. Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security concepts on SAP BTP, including XSUAA and role-based access management. Practical experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, Agentic AI concepts, and Human-in-the-Loop implementation approaches. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of architecture and solution design, while leading delivery within agile development teams. Nice to have Deep expertise in AI-enabled solutions and services on SAP BTP. Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP Integration Suite, and API management capabilities. Previous experience leading small development teams within banking, public funding, or regulated financial environments. German language skills. Benefits You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all — the agility, enthusiasm, and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence, and extensive customer network of a more established organization. At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and empowers you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you can chart your career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.
